_comment: Copy to deploy.config.json (gitignored) and fill in. Used by `npm run deploy` / `npm run deploy:restart` (scripts/deploy.mjs). Uploads backend files directly over FTP, touches the Passenger restart file, and verifies API health.
_timing: Tune progress indicators and timeout. expectRestartSec = expected Passenger restart time, waitTimeoutSec = maximum wait timeout.
_ftp: The portalback FTP account (home dir /api.attlarp.gr = the app root). Files matching .gitignore or safety rules (.env, node_modules) are ignored. restartFile is touched to restart Passenger.
